correctness.rationale: Independent uniform BST subtrees yield an exact conditional covariance recurrence; exceptional singleton and empty cases are explicitly handled. The affine leaf expectation cancels at all interior splits, leaving the boundary term (n-2)/(3n(n-1)). Telescoping proves the covariance for every n≥2. Record-indicator independence and the published leaf variance prove correlation asymptotics; an exhaustive and rational checker reproduces the proof premises.
